directionsRead: Funda umboniso ngamnye ukhethe into onokuyenza.
directionsEndings: Kukho iziphelo ezininzi. Zama enye indlela emva kokugqiba.
newSceneText: Chaza okwenzekayo, emva koko unxibelelanise ukhetho ngalunye nomboniso.
editingNote: Ukuhlela: yonke imiboniso iyaboniswa. Ukhetho likhonkco eliya ku-# lilandelwa yi-id yomboniso.
